contributions.detail: Three Schedule A sheets, 39 rows. p2's 15 rows sum to 30000 + 30000 + 25000 + 30000 + 2000 + 2500 + 26.19 + 3000 + 1035.51 + 25 + 500 + 100 + 103.83 + 3000 + 1000 = 128,290.53 = its printed subtotal. p3's 15 rows sum to 26.19 + 250 + 500 + 103.83 + 155.59 + 100 + 52.07 + 26.19 + 103.83 + 259.11 + 500 + 10000 + 5000 + 2500 + 10000 = 29,576.81 = its printed subtotal. p4's 9 rows sum to 500 + 41.72 + 103.83 + 1035.51 + 2000 + 100000 + 15000 + 20000 + 1000 = 139,681.06 = its printed subtotal. The three subtotals sum to 128,290.53 + 29,576.81 + 139,681.06 = 297,548.40, equal to the schedule's own sum-of-all-pages total AND to the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell Box B. Every page-subtotal gate closes independently, so no row is unattributed. THE LOAN IS INSIDE THE ANCHOR: 'Wasatch Acquisitions (Loan)' 100,000.00 is written on the contributions ledger and the filer's own p4 subtotal includes it — running the ladder (ADDENDUM B3) therefore makes it an ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION ROW, not a beginning-balance item; without it p4 would fall 100,000.00 short of its own printed subtotal and the side would miss Box B by the same amount. It is published as a row and flagged in its note. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints 401,833.36 and is CUMULATIVE — never summed as an increment.

in_kind_convention: monetary-only, and BOTH sides close on it exactly (297,548.40 and 192,260.57). BOTH conventions were tested and are IDENTICAL on this filing because no in-kind is claimed: this is the NEWER unversioned 2022 blank, whose Schedule A and Schedule B each carry a fifth 'In-Kind' checkbox column, so the ADDENDUM J1 hazard is live. It was handled as J1 requires — the Amount and In-Kind cells were cropped TOGETHER, as one full-column block per schedule page, and the pairing read from that single image rather than from vertical position. All 39 contribution checkboxes and all 21 expenditure checkboxes render EMPTY beside their own amounts, as do the boxes on the unused rows.
escalation_note: Because this is the chunk's largest filing (297k in and 192k out), EVERY amount cell on all five schedule pages was re-rendered rather than only the first and last: (1-5) one full-height Amount + In-Kind column crop per schedule page at 900 dpi, each rendering its rows in band order exactly as recorded (see each frame's measure_note for the figures). (6) the p3 footer at 900 dpi rendered 'Subtotal for this page $ 29,576.81' and 'Total Contributions Received $ 297,548.40'; the p2 footer rendered 128,290.53 / 297,548.40. (7) the p5 footer at 900 dpi rendered 'Subtotal for this page $ 99,441.08' and 'Total Expenditures Made $ 192,260.57'. No figure was in doubt at any point — the form is a typed fillable PDF, photocopied but crisp — and nothing was changed.

FORM: modern_boxAF on the NEWER UNVERSIONED 2022 blank — no version string in the footer, Schedule A headed 'City and State' with a fifth 'In-Kind' checkbox column, close box LETTERED 'G', SIX report types including End-of-Year, a 'Date of Filing' box, and NO Page field anywhere, so the filing is UNFOLIATED. Typed fillable PDF, photocopied and scanned (the header band and footer strip are degraded on every sheet and a yellow highlighter streak from the copier crosses one row of pp2-6, harming nothing).

EIGHT PAGES: p1 cover / p2-p4 SCHEDULE A (three sheets) / p5-p6 SCHEDULE B (two sheets) / p7 SUMMARY PAGE / p8 BLANK VERSO. Every page classified from its own printed header. NO CHECKLIST is bound into this filing.

THE BIGGEST FILING IN THE CHUNK and one of the largest county-office reports in the corpus: 297,548.40 received and 192,260.57 spent in a single pre-Primary period, 39 donor rows and 21 vendor rows, every page subtotal closing exactly. Four contributions of 25,000-100,000 and one 66,000 media buy sit in it.

THE 'CITY AND STATE' COLUMN IS BLANK ON ALL 39 CONTRIBUTION ROWS. This filing was published UNREDACTED — there is not a single redaction bar on any page, and the candidate's own home address is printed in the clear on the cover (deliberately NOT carried into this record, not into a field and not into a note, per the privacy rule). So the blank address column is the FILER'S OMISSION, a different fact from the county's redaction seen on the Cox filings in this same chunk and the same cycle. Note this is the newer blank whose address column asks only for city and state, so the privacy reduction would have been a no-op had he filled it.

A LOAN ON THE CONTRIBUTIONS LEDGER, resolved by the ladder and not by the word (ADDENDUM B3): 'Wasatch Acquisitions (Loan)' 100,000.00 IS an itemized contribution row here, because the filer's own page subtotal and Box B both include it. See recon.contributions.detail.

A DATE CELL HOLDING A RANGE: Schedule B line 18 is dated '4/1-6/18' with no year — a quarter of aggregated Stripe fees. Kept verbatim with needs_review=1; nothing was inferred from the report date.

NEITHER SCHEDULE IS CHRONOLOGICAL. Both ledgers jump backwards repeatedly (a 4/4/2022 donation is the 39th and last contribution row; a 5/24 expenditure sits below a 6/1 one). Transcribed in printed order and not reordered.

NO FILING FEE ROW appears on this filing, so it contributes no fee data point — and per ADDENDUM E1 the fee could not have been used to corroborate anything in any case.
